title: WU JEN EIGHTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 14 eighth level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R677 OA wu jen eighth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round sixty-four (capture pp. 207-213): the wu jen eighth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN EIGHTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 207-213 - the OA wu jen eighth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 207-213; compressed pp. 95-97); all 14 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the whirlwind print save garbling as 112 with the compressed pass reading 1/2, the half settled by the R674 fire breath precedent class, and summoning wind the FIRST school-less print of the wu jen levels, the bare heading in both stat-block passes and the roster silent, pinned 0 with the grid school comment carrying the code. The level carries TWO dual-school prints, both pinned primary alteration (the exaction precedent): finding the center the Alteration/Invocation dual and incendiary cloud the Alteration/Evocation dual both pinned 6. Alteration the most common school at seven spells, conjuration four (call, power word blind, symbol, whirlwind); antipathy/sympathy the lone enchantment/charm, mind blank the lone abjuration; NO divination, necromantic, invocation or illusion spell this level. The component census: 10 VSM, mind blank and summoning wind the verbal and somatic pair, power word blind the lone verbal-only, finding the center the lone SOMATIC-only - the first since the fifth level aiming at the target and shadow door pair. The casts: antipathy/sympathy the six-TURN cast pinned 360 segments, the longest of the wu jen levels yet; four one-turn (call, giant size, summoning wind, whirlwind); permanency the two-round cast pinned 20; polymorph any object and surelife the one-round casts; symbol eight segments, cloud trapeze five, incendiary cloud two, three single segments (finding the center, mind blank, power word blind); NO Casting Time: Special line this level. Call the lone negation save; antipathy/sympathy, polymorph any object and symbol special; incendiary cloud and whirlwind the two half saves. One reversible spell (giant size). The element column cross-checks the R669 dieWJT66L8Element grid: the FOUR tagged cells matching exactly - three Air (cloud trapeze, summoning wind, whirlwind) and one Fire (incendiary cloud), the richest Air column of the wu jen levels
